personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-mode command center built for instant readability and effortless telephony.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing around core dialpad for ergonomics. Tight, utility-driven spacing in list views for density.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar to allow list content to scroll underneath seamlessly.
Apply glass overlay on the in-call screen behind the main control grid, over the blurred contact avatar.
Use glass for sticky sticky headers (like the All/Missed chip filters in Recents).
dont's: Never blur the actual dialpad buttons, they must be solid and high-contrast.
Do not blur list items or form inputs.

screens.name: Sign In
screens.purpose: Multi-tenant authentication via company code, extension, and password.

states.error: Inline text below fields, shake animation on input, red border.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to 90% surfaceInverse, actually use dark theme so surface). Centered form container. Large primary CTA sticky above keyboard.

screens.name: Keypad
screens.purpose: Primary dialing interface and connection status.

states.loading: Connecting state in the status pill.

screens.layout: Header: Settings icon right, Registration Status pill center. Top area: Typed number display (huge condensed text), backspace button right-aligned. Middle/Bottom: 3x4 grid of circular dialpad buttons (surfaceTertiary background, pill radius). Bottom sticky: Large Success-colored (Green) call button centered.

screens.name: Recents
screens.purpose: Call history log with quick dial actions.
screens.layout: Header with title. Sticky sub-header with 'All' / 'Missed' segmented control / chips. List rows: Avatar or Initials left, Name/Number center, timestamp and duration right. Missed calls use brand/error color for the name.

screens.name: Contacts
screens.layout: Sticky search bar at top. Horizontal scroll view for Favorites (avatars in circles with names). Vertical list below for All Contacts with alphabetical section headers. Tap row to call.

screens.name: Voicemail
screens.layout: List of voicemails showing caller name, duration, timestamp. Expanding row reveals playback slider, play/pause, and quick-call button.

screens.name: Incoming Call
screens.purpose: Full-screen alert for an incoming SIP call.
screens.layout: Full screen overlay. Large avatar top center. Caller Name/Number below. Pulsing status text. Bottom 1/3: Two large buttons side by side (Decline in Red, Accept in Green) or a slide-to-answer bar.

screens.name: In-Call
screens.layout: Blurred background of caller avatar. Top: Caller info and active timer. Center: 3x2 grid of circular controls (Mute, Keypad, Speakerphone, Add Call, Hold, Transfer) with icons + labels. Bottom: Large Error-colored (Red) End Call button.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design follows Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility), focusing on a high-contrast, tactical aesthetic suitable for a premium business softphone.

BANNED: Any use of blue, indigo, or purple. The primary accent is Orange/Amber (brand), while standard Green (success) and Red (error) are STRICTLY reserved for Call and End/Decline actions respectively.
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed for numerical data (dialpad inputs, phone numbers, call timers) to maximize readability at large sizes, and Satoshi for all standard UI labels/body.
Dialpad Buttons: Keys must be circular (pill radius). Ensure large touch targets (at least 64x64) and ample spacing. Dialpad must NOT be hidden behind sub-menus.
In-Call & Incoming screens: Apply a strong gradient scrim (transparent to dense surface color) over the blurred caller avatar backdrop to ensure the foreground text/buttons exceed WCAG AA contrast.
Implement haptics using expo-haptics across all keypresses, especially on the dialpad to mimic physical device feedback.
Settings should be accessed via a header icon in the Keypad tab, saving bottom-bar space for the 4 core telephony tabs (Keypad, Recents, Contacts, Voicemail).
